The aliases are the paper's short title (case-sensitive, so that the lower-case phrase 'working with AI' in the archive's prose does not count as the name), its score, its arXiv number, its repository and its first author. 'Microsoft', 'Copilot' and 'Bing Copilot' are not aliases: Microsoft is the operator and the homonym's subject (the company's own AI products and workforce, composed by T), Bing Copilot the product whose conversations the entity observes.
